pagePlan.contentCoverage:
Verified 2026-10-22 via Chrome: official Instagram @talkie.space links Carrd. Bio hours 08.00–22.00. Carrd links only menu PDF, location and WhatsApp 6282130445909. PDF page 24 matches address/contact. All 24 pages rendered; 22 product pages manually transcribed. Prices reflect linked menu accessed today, not owner confirmation of current availability. Mineral Water has two prices without named sizes, retained as unnamed price options. Import filter coffee: ask barista, no invented price.
Brand: PDF black/white, heavy sans headings, condensed category accents, warm food imagery. DM Sans is an open-license optical substitute, not a claim of official font. Original white logo cropped from p1 artwork. No invented facilities, reviews, capacities.
Bio coverage: PDF -> complete catalogue; Maps -> visit; WhatsApp -> reservation CTA; Instagram breakfast Sept 22 -> breakfast section with hours and from 15K; cupping Oct 21 -> past event, no upcoming booking claim; special-day reel -> ask admin, no invented package. Blue matcha carousel -> omitted as price/variant absent in linked menu.
Asset routes: Instagram profile/posts reviewed, PDF supplied sufficient full resolution food photography; downloader unnecessary for food already in official PDF. Google Images searched in Chrome and source Instagram C9md_4Uy2p6 identified but third-party interior not reused (avoid unneeded rights exposure). GoFood merchant opened, Safety check blocked; no bypass, PDF is stronger dine-in source. Official Carrd facade downloaded. No stock or AI food. PDF flattened images require crops; group compositions used as section images, ambiguous SKU images remain null.
Alternative A initially type-led; final render classified split-product/story-to-offer/compact-rows/alternating-scenes/product-craft after visual review: visible bold type, coffee spread, breakfast then complete catalogue and visit. Alternative B split-product/product-first/open-grid/minimal/curated-selection rejected: sparse confidently identifiable SKU photos would create many empty cards. Mobile: headline then coffee image, stacked breakfast, filter and magnifier same row, two-column menu rows collapse to one; no sticky toolbar or carousel needed. All 94 offerings remain discoverable without pagination.
Rights: official media authentic, republication rights pending; local concept only, noindex. No push, deploy or outreach authorized.

2026-10-23 revision: archived 2026-10-22 source facts/assets retained, not newly reverified. Source feed screenshots and PDF are missing from checkout; public crops are present and viewed. All 94 items remain reachable through category tabs, cross-category search and replacing 8-item pagination. User explicitly authorized Codex cloud build override via parent. No publication or outreach.
